title: Sampled contraction removes exactly one vertex
statement: Let $G$ be a multigraph on a vertex type $\alpha$ with decidable equality, and let $c$ be a sampled edge occurrence of $G$, i.e.\ an element of its finite set of edge occurrences. Writing $G_c$ for the multigraph obtained by contracting $G$ along the edge underlying $c$, the number of vertices of $G_c$ equals the number of vertices of $G$ minus one.
hypotheses_covered: G is a multigraph on a vertex type with decidable equality
c is a sampled edge occurrence of G (an element of graphChoiceSpace G)
replaced: Contracting along any sampled edge occurrence decreases the vertex count by exactly one.
